description: Never automerge mise tool pins. The same versions are mirrored into files Renovate does not update, so a green build proves nothing about the copies left behind.

packageRules.description: mise tool pins are reviewed by hand
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ This bumps a tool version in `mise.toml`. Renovate updates that file only — check the mirrored copies (`.nvmrc`, `go.mod`, `engines.node`, workflow env) before merging.
